title: PI Lunch & Learn: Building a Referral Relationship That Lasts
summary: Two firms and two providers who have worked together for years explain how the relationship actually started and what keeps it going.
description: Referral relationships get talked about constantly and explained almost never. This session brings four people who have worked together for years to describe the unglamorous version: the first case, the first problem, and why they kept going.
Useful for anyone building a practice from a standing start, and for anyone whose referral sources have quietly gone quiet.
